name: Novoprotein Scientific Inc.
summary: Novoprotein Scientific Inc. researches, develops, produces, and sells raw materials and technology solutions for biopharmaceuticals enterprises. The company offers mRNA vaccine drug raw materials, immunodiagnostic and molecular diagnostic raw materials, gene and cell therapy, molecular research reagents, cytokines, target proteins, cell lines, reference antibody, recombinant antibodies, enzymes and reagents, matrix gel and culture medium, and protein and virus research related products. It offers its products and services in the fields of biopharmaceuticals, mRNA vaccines and drugs, in vitro diagnostics, basic research of life sciences, and other areas.
